name: Retail Credit File Review & Underwriting
description: Standard underwriting workflow for retail loan review, eligibility calculation, and credit sanction.

steps.name: Intake & Identification
steps.description: Collect borrower application, identify borrower profile, and verify identity via KYC records.

steps.name: Bureau & History Check
steps.description: Pull credit bureau report (e.g., CIBIL/Experian), check repayment track record and score cutoffs.

steps.name: Financial Extraction & Computation
steps.description: Extract declared income, compute debt-to-income (DTI / FOIR), and verify disposable income.

steps.name: Collateral & LTV Check
steps.description: Evaluate independent property valuation and apply statutory/internal LTV cap to determine maximum loan.

steps.name: Rule & Policy Evaluation
steps.description: Execute deterministic policy rules (age, score, DTI, LTV, employer category). Flag exceptions for senior credit committee.

steps.name: Draft Credit Memo
steps.description: Generate structured credit appraisal memo citing specific rule outcomes, verified figures, and conditions precedent.

name: Customer Due Diligence & KYC Onboarding
description: Regulatory process for onboarding customer accounts and verifying beneficial ownership.

steps.name: Document Collection
steps.description: Obtain officially valid documents (OVD) for identity and permanent address proof.

steps.name: Screening & Verification
steps.description: Screen applicant names against sanctions lists, PEP databases, and negative profiles.

steps.name: Risk Categorization
steps.description: Assign customer risk rating (Low, Medium, High) based on jurisdiction, profession, and turnover.

steps.name: Periodic Review Scheduling
steps.description: Establish schedule for customer due diligence refresh (e.g., 2 years for High risk, 8-10 years for Low risk).

name: Stressed Asset Management & IRACP Resolution Workflow
description: End-to-end operational protocol for monitoring delinquency, provisioning capital, and executing legal recovery under RBI guidelines.

steps.name: Early Warning & SMA Tagging
steps.description: Daily automated batch classification into SMA-0 (1-30 DPD), SMA-1 (31-60 DPD), and SMA-2 (61-90 DPD). Issue cure notices to borrower.

steps.name: NPA Tagging & Interest Derecognition
steps.description: Upon crossing 90 DPD, stop recognizing interest on accrual basis. Reverse unrealized accrued interest from profit and loss account.

steps.name: Regulatory Provisioning Allocation
steps.description: Allocate minimum 15% provision on secured substandard assets, 25% on unsecured, and update Risk-Weighted Asset reserves.

steps.name: Resolution Plan Formulation
steps.description: 30-day review period to structure resolution plan, bilateral restructuring, or debt consolidation before legal escalation.

steps.name: Enforcement & Legal Recovery
steps.description: Serve SARFAESI Section 13(2) 60-day demand notice. If unpaid, initiate Section 13(4) physical possession or file insolvency petition at NCLT.

name: MSME Working Capital Appraisal & Nayak MPBF Workflow
description: Standardized underwriting assessment for granting fund-based cash credit limits to MSME industrial and trading enterprises.

steps.name: Financial Intake & Churn Analysis
steps.description: Collect 3-year audited financials, GST returns, and 12-month operational bank statements. Verify sales churn through primary account.

steps.name: Turnover Validation & Nayak Assessment
steps.description: Verify projected turnover reasonableness. Calculate 25% Working Capital Requirement, 5% borrower margin, and 20% MPBF limit.

steps.name: Drawing Power (DP) Formulation
steps.description: Set monthly Drawing Power rules: Paid Stock minus 25% margin plus eligible Book Debts (< 90 days) minus 30% margin.

steps.name: Covenant & Benchmark Validation
steps.description: Ensure term debt DSCR exceeds 1.20x and Current Ratio is above 1.25x before credit sanction.

steps.name: Sanction Memo & Charge Creation
steps.description: Issue sanction letter, execute hypothecation of current assets, and file ROC / CERSAI charge within statutory timelines.

name: Digital Lending Onboarding & Direct Disbursal Workflow
description: Compliant workflow for originating unsecured personal or merchant digital loans under RBI Digital Lending Guidelines.

steps.name: Digital Intake & Identity Verification
steps.description: Capture customer application through Regulated Entity/LSP app. Execute Aadhaar OTP or CKYC retrieval with biometric validation.

steps.name: Automated Bureau Scrub & Score Filter
steps.description: Real-time API pull from CIBIL/Experian. Confirm bureau score >= 700 and zero DPD > 30 in preceding 6 months.

steps.name: Key Fact Statement (KFS) Issuance
steps.description: Present mandatory standardized KFS displaying transparent Annual Percentage Rate (APR), EMI schedule, and all fees.

steps.name: Cooling-Off Agreement & e-Sign
steps.description: Obtain Aadhaar e-Sign on loan contract with explicit 3-day look-up period allowing penalty-free exit.

steps.name: Direct Account Disbursement
steps.description: Trigger automated direct credit to borrower verified bank account via NEFT/IMPS with zero pass-through via LSP accounts.
